description: For natural numbers m and n, membership of their set realizations is equivalent to m less than n, and inclusion is equivalent to m at most n.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.NaturalNumbersAsSets.naturalSet_order.{u} (m n : ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.Entry.NaturalNumbersAsSets.naturalSet m ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.NaturalNumbersAsSets.naturalSet n ↔ m < n) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.Entry.NaturalNumbersAsSets.naturalSet m ⊆ Lemmatheca.Entry.NaturalNumbersAsSets.naturalSet n ↔ m ≤ n)
